clue.text: Peace gesture that will come to a 'sticky' end

definitions.text: Peace gesture that will come to a 'sticky' end

parts.words: Peace gesture that will come to a 'sticky' end
parts.note: an offer of reconciliation named after a bough from a fruit tree, and a bough cut off ends up as a stick, hence the joke on a sticky end

explanation.surface: A conciliatory gesture that is doomed to end badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sticky end' usually means a nasty fate; here it is literal, since a branch broken off becomes a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding out a sprig from this Mediterranean tree has symbolised a wish for peace since ancient times.

clue.text: Hair raising devices for sailors

explanation.surface: Hair-raising devices for sailors.

clue.text: Disappear with Romeo in Japan?

parts.note: to vanish is to disappear

explanation.definitionFit: Japan is a glossy lacquer, a kind of hard coating, so it is an example of the answer.

clue.text: Student found with ecstasy after arrest gets stir

clue.text: What can make meats tender is attached to this

explanation.definitionFit: Old railway engines pulled a coal and water wagon called a tender coupled directly behind them.
